convert_doxygen_xml_to_boostbook: run the doxproc script to convert Doxygen XML files in a directory to BoostBook XML format
translate_doxygen_compounddef_to_boostbo: use the Doxygen2BoostBook class to translate Doxygen compounddef nodes like class and struct into BoostBook elements
translate_doxygen_memberdef_to_boostbook: use the Doxygen2BoostBook class to translate Doxygen memberdef nodes like functions and variables into BoostBook elements
generate_boostbook_index_from_doxygen: enable the index option in Doxygen2BoostBook to generate class and type index sections from Doxygen XML
rewrite_doxygen_ids_to_boostbook_ids: use the Doxygen2BoostBook internal method to rewrite Doxygen reference IDs to BoostBook-compatible IDs in links
